title: Act 4: Echos of the Past
changeNote:
## 1.2.1 Changes

- Fixed a multiplayer resume black screen caused by deck-preview cleanup accessing an already-freed lobby screen. The same cleanup error when starting a new multiplayer run is also fixed.
- Multiplayer Continue previews now show the full saved party's Corrupted Decks before the other players rejoin, including runs that have not reached Act 4. Once opponents are selected, the preview keeps using the decks saved with the run.
- Added a recovery shortcut for broken Corrupted Decks. Right-click "View Corrupted Deck" 10 times in a row to clear the saved opponent and its backups. Exhaust effects start on the fourth click; the tenth burns away the button.
- Solo resets affect only the active profile's opponent. Co-op resets are host-only and affect only that exact party.
- Using the recovery shortcut on a Continue screen also clears that run's frozen opponent without deleting the run or changing the players' decks. Co-op Continue resets close the lobby so everyone can rejoin with the corrected save.
